Method of Attack: Downloading scripts that steal sensitive data from browser, messaging apps (Telegram, Signal, Session), and cryptocurrency wallet details (Exodus, Electrum, Monero)
Sending all stolen data to a Telegram channel
Attack Vector: Malicious Python packages uploaded to PyPI
Promotion via StackExchange comments with links to malicious packages
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious packages named spl-types, raydium, sol-structs, sol-instruct, raydium-sdk on PyPI
Comments with links to malicious packages on StackExchange
